subject: Liaison rhythm, MAP alignment, and final close countdown
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Greene <t.greene@vanguardhealth.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vanguardhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Liaison rhythm, MAP draft, and EB meeting windows

Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our ask, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (Vanguard_MAP_v1.xlsx) that maps deliverables, owners, and dates across evaluation and procurement. Two quick asks from our side to help lock the close timeline:

1) Executive liaison: who will be the primary executive (sponsor/decision-owner) we should route a one-pager and an invite to?
2) EB (board/executive brief) windows: can you confirm two 60–90 minute blocks the week of Dec 1–7 where Maria (or another sponsor) + procurement can attend?

High-level timeline we're targeting (draft):
- Nov 25–30: finalize MAP and one-pager for exec review
- Dec 1–7: exec briefing + procurement terms discussion
- Dec 8–10: final contract redline and PO issuance

Marissa, Rishi — tagging you to own the one-pager (Marissa) and compliance/tech checklist (Rishi).

Tom/Elena — if you can confirm sponsor name and two candidate windows by EOD tomorrow we will lock invites and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: Vanguard_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet of milestones/owners)

From: Tom Greene <t.greene@vanguardhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@vanguardhealth.com>, procurement@vanguardhealth.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Liaison rhythm, MAP draft, and EB meeting windows

Naomi — thanks, this looks good. Quick answers:

- Executive sponsor: Maria Ortega (CFO). I will send a short intro note to Maria and copy you; she is the primary decision-owner for FY27 vendor spend.
- Candidate EB windows (ET): Dec 2 between 16:00–17:30 or Dec 3 between 10:00–11:30. Maria prefers afternoons but can make morning on Dec 3.

Procurement note: please include the standard data residency + SOC 2 language in the compliance packet; procurement wants a single doc with security artifacts. I cc'd procurement to flag any missing items early.

I'll follow up with Maria once we have the one-pager.

—Tom
Tom Greene
VP, Partnerships | Vanguard Health Systems
t.greene@vanguardhealth.com | (617) 222-3344

Subject: Internal: Vanguard — sponsor confirmed (Maria) and EB windows

Team — summary from Tom below: Maria Ortega (CFO) will be the exec sponsor. EB windows being considered: Dec 2 16:00–17:30 ET or Dec 3 10:00–11:30 ET. Procurement flagged the need for a consolidated security/compliance packet (SOC 2, data residency, retention).

Action items (owners and quick beats):
- Marissa: draft a 1-page exec brief targeted at Maria (value, expected ROI, one-slide MAP + ask). Due: EOD Nov 27.
- Rishi: verify the technical appendix and confirm the runtime footprint for their expected concurrency profile; add a short note on SLA/latency expectations. Due: Nov 30 morning.
- Priya: assemble compliance artifacts (SOC 2 summary, KMS/HSM notes, data retention policy) into a single zip we can hand to procurement. Due: Nov 30 EOD.

I'll align calendar invites once Marissa's one-pager is live and Tom confirms final window. Keep updates brief so we can pass a tidy package to Maria.

Naomi

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:04:00 -0800
Subject: Draft one-pager + proposed EB agenda

Naomi / team — attached is a draft one-pager for Maria (Maria_Ortega_onepager.pdf). I pulled the two candidate EB windows into a calendar note and sketched a 90-minute agenda below:

Proposed EB agenda (90 mins)
- 0–10: Sponsor intro and business context (Maria + Tom)
- 10–40: Executive summary (value, go-to-live ramp, expected ROI) — Naomi
- 40–80: Technical deep dive & risk mitigation (Rishi)
- 80–90: Procurement & next steps (procurement rep + Priya)

Attachments included: one-pager (PDF) + an annotated MAP workbook (Vanguard_MAP_v1.xlsx) with colors for 'owner' and 'due date'.

Notes: I suggest we push for the Dec 2 16:00 ET slot as primary; if Maria prefers Dec 3 morning we keep that as alt. I'll incorporate any last-minute edits from Naomi and send the finalized invite with the agenda.

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Maria_Ortega_onepager.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Final: MAP, exec brief, and confirmed EB on Dec 2 16:00 ET

Tom / Elena / Maria (when you see this) — quick update and final asks: we have the one-pager and compliance packet assembled; details below and next steps to close the week.

Confirmed items:
- Executive sponsor: Maria Ortega (CFO) — Naomi will send a single-slide intro + ask.
- EB date/time: Dec 2, 2026 at 16:00 ET (confirmed with Maria via Tom). Calendar invite and agenda to follow.
- MAP: Vanguard_MAP_v1.xlsx (attached) — owners and due dates color-coded.
- Compliance zip: compliance_packet_v2.zip (contains SOC 2 summary, data residency note, retention policy excerpt, and KMS overview).

Action owners and deadlines (final):
- Marissa: finalize one-pager and send invite (done) — please include the 90-min agenda and a short list of prep materials (1-page each for execs).
- Rishi: technical appendix ready for handoff by Dec 1 12:00 ET.
- Priya: upload compliance_packet_v2.zip to the shared link and send to procurement by Dec 1 17:00 ET.
- Naomi: send intro note to Maria and include the HubSpot MAP link + ask for final agenda additions.

Links / attachments: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/5001234 (deal record), https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP_draft_v4 (shared MAP narrative).

If there are no material changes I will finalize invites this afternoon and include a 10-minute prep call for our side (internal) on Dec 1 at 09:00 ET.

Thanks everyone — let’s keep this tight and deliverable-focused.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
